summary: Building a Vite+React procurement app (52 pages: 5 design-system, 4 archetype templates, 42 buyer/supplier module pages, 1 not-found). ProcureSprint design system kept. Initial issue: Vite not installed in dependencies, breaking preview. Fixed by moving vite/vitest from devDependencies to regular dependencies. All pages render, 141 tests pass, no script errors. User requests header redesign from Figma "ready for dev" screens: replace plain white top bar + separate page head with single deep teal wave-textured banner containing title/metadata, icons (bell, Ask Me pill, Refresh), and record action buttons below. Figma link had access issues; user provided reference screenshots. No header changes applied yet pending Figma access confirmation.
